columns.name: staff_id
columns.label: Staff ID
columns.desc: ST-001… issued by the web app

columns.name: full_name
columns.label: Full name
columns.desc: Name shown in the web app

columns.name: email
columns.label: Google email
columns.desc: Google account used to open the web app

columns.name: access_level
columns.label: App access
columns.desc: Viewer (read) / Editor (add, edit) / Admin (+ delete, masters, users)

columns.name: active
columns.label: Active
columns.desc: Y = can open the web app; N = blocked

columns.name: scope
columns.label: Scope / description
columns.desc: Countries or regions covered by the market

columns.name: customer_name
columns.label: Customer name
columns.desc: Full customer name (used as the customer channel in summaries)

columns.name: item_id
columns.label: Item ID
columns.desc: Unique code of the quotation item

columns.name: item_name
columns.label: Item name
columns.desc: Item name, used consistently across all projects

columns.name: unit
columns.label: Unit of the unit price
columns.desc: Unit that the item unit price is quoted in (one unit per item for all projects, so prices are comparable). Pick from Config > Unit

columns.name: material_group
columns.label: Material group
columns.desc: Material group this item represents (drives selling price / gross margin summaries by material group). Pick from Config > Material group

columns.name: description
columns.label: General description
columns.desc: General description. The detailed specification that drives the price is entered in Material_Prices

columns.name: effective_date
columns.label: Effective date
columns.desc: Rate applies from this date until a newer row exists

columns.name: currency
columns.label: Currency
columns.desc: Currency to convert (other than the base currency)

columns.name: rate
columns.label: Rate (1 unit of currency = ? base currency)

columns.label: FX row ID
columns.desc: FX-0001… issued by the web app (R05). effective_date + currency stay unique

columns.name: price_id
columns.label: Price row ID
columns.desc: Unique code of the price row

columns.name: specification
columns.label: Specification
columns.desc: Specification that drives the unit price (grade, thickness, standard, coating...). Each different spec of the same material is a separate price row

columns.name: effective_date
columns.label: Price effective date
columns.desc: Date the price starts to apply

columns.name: unit_price
columns.label: Unit price (original currency / unit)
columns.desc: Unit price in its original currency per unit

columns.name: fx_rate
columns.label: FX rate
columns.desc: Latest rate dated on or before the price effective date (from FX_Rates); 1 for the base currency

columns.name: fx_usd
columns.label: FX rate - USD
columns.desc: USD rate on the price effective date (R05)

columns.name: job_no

columns.name: sell_currency

columns.name: cost_currency

columns.desc: Currency used to enter item unit costs

columns.label: FX date
columns.desc: Date used to look up FX rates for the project

columns.name: fx_sell
columns.label: FX rate - selling
columns.desc: Rate of the selling currency on the FX date

columns.name: fx_cost
columns.label: FX rate - cost
columns.desc: Rate of the cost currency on the FX date

columns.name: item_rows
columns.label: Item rows
columns.desc: Number of rows of the project in Project_Items

columns.label: Avg gross margin % - job

columns.desc: Material cost per unit, in the project's cost currency
